result.summary: The food delivery app page renders mostly well, but there are a few layout issues related to card truncation and inconsistent styling of interactive elements.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, which may look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a clearer visual affordance (e.g., peek of next card or scroll indicator) and ensure text truncation uses ellipsis consistently to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent: one has a white background circle while the other has a dark/transparent background, creating visual inconsistency across the restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background and contrast across all cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is heavily cropped, showing only the image with no title or details, making it appear incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure at least the restaurant name is visible above the fold or adjust card height so partial cards clearly indicate more content below.
